items.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: when I was with Woody Herman’s band

ctx.x: I was very young and I couldn’t talk, I used to box. I wanted to be a fighter. And there was one, you know when you first go in they send you to I think Fort Dix, the big camp where before they send you out to wherever you’re going to go, they get thousands of guys there and all you do is walk around picking up cigarette butts. They have to kill time until they find a place where you’re going to go. Well 39 years old I think was the age where you got dis— you couldn’t get in the Army after 39. And I was 18. And…

were much older to me too. I went into the Eighth Armored Division as a tank driver. And you know, like I say, in the Army they don’t tell you what you’re going to do. So I was a tank driver, I was driving a tank. Then they put me in the band. They put me in the band because they needed — nobody played vibes. I wanted to play drums so bad, really, but they didn’t have vibes so they put me in the band. Now the infiltration course is where they have barbed wire about this high and you have to crawl underneath…

items.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 5, 2021 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: until I got with Woody Herman’s band really.

ctx.x: Well this is sort of a two part question. I wonder if you had definite goals for a life in music and did your mother support them? Did she think you were going into the right career?

Well it started like I never had goals. I never had goals. And I’ve been blessed things fell in my lap. I never would have auditioned with Benny Goodman, he called me. I never auditioned with Woody Herman, he called me. I never auditioned with Steve Allen, Regis Philbin, they called me. So I’ve been blessed in that way, and I never had goals. I wanted to play good. That was my goal if anything, I just wanted to play to where I enjoyed it. I never, you know it’s wild to say I never play for an audience. I play for…
Okay yes that’s — I’m going to catch a plan out there and get that.
